passages.text: Nia wants a different style for her old jacket, but she cannot buy a new one. The jacket still fits well, so Mum suggests changing only a few small parts. They replace the plain buttons with blue ones and add a white stripe. Nia wears it to school and tells her friends how they changed it. Two friends ask if she can help them plan similar changes. The simple look becomes popular with her friends, although the jacket is not new. Nia keeps a drawing of the jacket to plan another change later.

parallelText.en: Nia wants a different style for her old jacket, but she cannot buy a new one.
parallelText.zh: 妮娅想给旧外套换种风格，但她买不了新的。

parallelText.en: The jacket still fits well, so Mum suggests changing only a few small parts.
parallelText.zh: 外套仍很合身，因此妈妈建议只改几个小地方。

parallelText.en: They replace the plain buttons with blue ones and add a white stripe.
parallelText.zh: 她们把普通纽扣换成蓝色的，还加了一条白色条纹。

parallelText.en: Nia wears it to school and tells her friends how they changed it.
parallelText.zh: 妮娅穿去学校，告诉朋友们她们是怎么改的。

parallelText.en: Two friends ask if she can help them plan similar changes.
parallelText.zh: 两位朋友问她能否帮忙设计类似的改动。

parallelText.en: The simple look becomes popular with her friends, although the jacket is not new.
parallelText.zh: 虽然外套不是新的，这个简洁的样子却受到朋友们喜爱。

parallelText.en: Nia keeps a drawing of the jacket to plan another change later.

passages.text: Our music club is preparing a short show for families. We want the music to include something for every visitor. Lea chooses a Chinese song, while Tom finds a Western song in a British music book. The final mix gives the show two different sounds without making it too long. Both songs have an easy part that the audience can repeat. We write the words on large cards and practise the change between the songs. At the show, even people who do not know the songs join in at that part.

parallelText.en: Our music club is preparing a short show for families.
parallelText.zh: 我们音乐社团正为家庭观众准备一个短节目。

parallelText.en: We want the music to include something for every visitor.
parallelText.zh: 我们希望音乐中有每位来宾都能参与的部分。

parallelText.en: Lea chooses a Chinese song, while Tom finds a Western song in a British music book.
parallelText.zh: 莉娅选了一首中国歌曲，汤姆在一本英国音乐书里找到一首西方歌曲。

parallelText.en: The final mix gives the show two different sounds without making it too long.
parallelText.zh: 最后的结合让节目有两种不同的声音，又不会过长。

parallelText.en: Both songs have an easy part that the audience can repeat.
parallelText.zh: 两首歌曲都有观众能够重复跟唱的简单部分。

parallelText.en: We write the words on large cards and practise the change between the songs.
parallelText.zh: 我们把歌词写在大卡片上，练习两首歌之间的衔接。

parallelText.en: At the show, even people who do not know the songs join in at that part.
parallelText.zh: 演出时，即使不熟悉歌曲的人也在那一部分跟唱。
